title: Tilted
description: Crossbows, unlimited crossbows, but no crossbows.
body: ![Mod Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/adcfe7a2cd437576d3dacb6bcda084d6ef63a619_0.webp) A Minecraft mod about crossbows. Adds leaning, aiming down sights, scopes, barrels, skins - a LOT of skins - and gives a use to the fletching table! :D The main features of this mod are split into 3 parts: - Crossbow Focus Mode - Fletching Table - Smithing Table Available for 26.2! Newer updates are backported down to 1.21.8. ## Crossbow Focus Mode Allows you to lean, Aim Down Sights and have more control over your aim. ## Fletching Table Allows you to pick attachments to put on your crossbow, affecting it's stats. ### Barrels - Suppressor ![Supressor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2402e1c9fb37cd0d351bd1708391b7909635de39_0.webp) Silences crossbow sounds & arrow trial. - Extended Barrel ![Extended Barrel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b15e477329df92d7c9b84fedbb7fef764b67ca17_0.webp) Increases power, but increases spread. - Flash Hider ![Flash Hider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8289ac82cd34322450054c2772bd30cabb742e9_0.webp) Greatly reduces spread. - Compensator ![Compensator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c78ca8267bca2e2575832c293fc1599b25facad_0.webp) Greatly decreases charge time. ### Scopes - Iron Sights ![Iron Sights](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2284b90539a9d3097fbb9af8636c59e5577a7f99_0.webp) Fast ADS time, but minimal zoom. - Magnified A ![Magnified A](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34582658735864797890ea3fb82411fb9d7caf8a.png) Slower ADS time, but more zoom. - Magnified B ![Magnified B](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98d18708623a17a60cd1e4dc68e749746015970e.png) Hides crosshair when aiming. - Telescopic ![Telescopic](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/38561e0cb162aa3b11b6fe41ff25cf2c251ad616.png) Significant zoom, but impaired vision. - Microscope ![Microscope](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e0333d676723ecb3f55adb3484efc8bda60ade3.png) errrrrrrr......... ## Smithing Table Choose between a LOT of skins to put on your crossbow! Recieve crates with a rare chance, with them being added to spawn in most trial chamber loot tables with a 1/5 chance.. **NOTE: due to some backend changes in 26.3, those versions still use the old system of crates being added to every loot table at a rare chance.** All skins use string alongside a crossbow in a smithing table to skin the crossbow, except for one. The "Ice" smithing template allows you to dye your crossbow any dye color (except for a few).
